```{r,fig.height=12,fig.width=5}
rm(list=ls())
setwd("~/Desktop/codes")
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggthemes)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggtext)     # ← 用于渲染 HTML 富文本（粗体 + 斜体 + 下标）

# 读取并过滤数据
plot_data1 <- read_excel("~/Desktop/codes/data/Fig1_data.xlsx", sheet = "a_e")
plot_data1[is.na(plot_data1)] <- ""
plot_data1 <- plot_data1 %>% filter(group %in% c("pH", "metals", "MRG", "ARG", "HP"))

custom_colors <- c("N50cont" = "red", "N50cess" = "blue")
plot_data <- plot_data1

# 注意：这里统一用普通连字符 "-"，避免非断连字符导致匹配失败
plot_data$significant <- ifelse(plot_data$pval < 0.05, "Significant", "Non-significant")
plot_data$fill_color <- ifelse(plot_data$significant == "Significant",
                               custom_colors[plot_data$Subgroup],
                               "white")
plot_data$point_shape <- ifelse(plot_data$significant == "Significant", 16, 21)
plot_data$Subgroup <- factor(plot_data$Subgroup, levels = c("YN50", "NN50"))
plot_data$Subgroup <- factor(plot_data$Subgroup, labels = c("N50cont", "N50cess"))
plot_data$group <- factor(plot_data$group, levels = c("pH", "metals", "MRG", "ARG", "HP"))
plot_data$group <- factor(plot_data$group, labels = c("Soil pH", 
                                                      "Heavy metals",
                                                      "MRGs", 
                                                      "ARGs",
                                                      "Potential human pathogens"))

## ========== p 标签位置 ==========
## Soil pH：蓝色也右移；Heavy metals：红蓝都左移；其余面板保持原偏移
plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    label_x = case_when(
      # ---- Soil pH ----
      as.character(group) == "Soil pH" & Subgroup == "N50cont" ~ estimate + 0.22,  # 红：右移
      as.character(group) == "Soil pH" & Subgroup == "N50cess" ~ estimate + 0.12,  # 蓝：右移
      # ---- Heavy metals ----
      as.character(group) == "Heavy metals" & Subgroup == "N50cont" ~ estimate - 0.02,  # 红：左移
      as.character(group) == "Heavy metals" & Subgroup == "N50cess" ~ estimate - 0.10,  # 蓝：左移
      # ---- 其它面板默认 ----
      Subgroup == "N50cont" ~ estimate + 0.08,
      TRUE                  ~ estimate
    ),
    label_y = as.numeric(Subgroup) + 0.12,
    p_label = ifelse(
      pval < 0.001,
      paste0("<b><i>p</i> = ", formatC(pval, format = "e", digits = 1), "</b>"),
      paste0("<b><i>p</i> = ", formatC(pval, format = "f", digits = 3), "</b>")
    )
  )

# 绘图
p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = estimate, y = Subgroup)) +
  facet_wrap(.~group, ncol = 1) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmax = estimate + 1.96 * se,
                     xmin = estimate - 1.96 * se,
                     color = Subgroup,
                     linetype = "95% CI"),
                 size = 1.5, height = 0, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmax = estimate + se,
                     xmin = estimate - se,
                     color = Subgroup,
                     linetype = "±SE"),
                 size = 2.5, height = 0, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = fill_color, color = Subgroup, shape = significant),
             size = 5, stroke = 1, alpha = 0.5) +  
  # HTML-rendered p label: p bold italic, rest bold upright
  geom_richtext(aes(x = label_x, y = label_y, label = p_label, color = Subgroup),
                size = 3.2, hjust = 0.42, vjust = 0.1,
                fill = NA, label.color = NA, label.padding = unit(0, "pt"),
                show.legend = FALSE) +
  # ↓↓↓ 修改 1：color 图例标签用 HTML 下标，并用 breaks 反转图例顺序（N50cess 在上）
  scale_color_manual(
    values = custom_colors,
    name   = "Treatment",
    breaks = c("N50cess", "N50cont"),   # ← 仅新增这一行
    labels = c("N50cont" = "N50<sub>cont</sub>",
               "N50cess" = "N50<sub>cess</sub>")
  ) +
  scale_fill_identity() + 
  # ↓↓↓ 修改 2：y 轴刻度标签用 HTML 下标
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = c("N50cont" = "N50<sub>cont</sub>",
               "N50cess" = "N50<sub>cess</sub>")
  ) +
  # Significance legend labels with italic p
  scale_shape_manual(name = "Significance",
                     values = c("Significant" = 16, "Non-significant" = 21),
                     labels = c("Significant"     = "<i>p</i> < 0.05",
                                "Non-significant" = "<i>p</i> > 0.05")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(name = "Error bars",
                        values = c("95% CI" = "solid", "±SE" = "solid"),
                        guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list( 
                          size = c(1.5, 2.5),
                          alpha = c(0.4, 0.7),
                          color = "black"))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "gray", linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5) +
  labs(x = 'Effect size of nitrogen addition (LRR)',
       y = '',
       title = " ") +
  theme_few() +
  theme(
    # ↓↓↓ 修改 3：拆开 axis.text，y 轴用 element_markdown 渲染下标
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_markdown(size = 12, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "right", 
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
    # HTML rendering for legend text (italic p + subscripts)
    legend.text = element_markdown(size = 12),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = "white"), 
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", size = 1.5, linetype = "solid")
  )
p

ggsave("~/Desktop/codes/figures/Fig1a-e.pdf", width = 5, height = 12,
       device = cairo_pdf)
```

```{r cars,fig.width=5,fig.height=5}
rm(list = ls())
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(readxl)
library(ggtext)     # ← 用于 HTML 渲染的标签（下标、斜体、粗体）
setwd("~/Desktop/codes")

# ---------- Read data ----------
df <- read_excel("~/Desktop/codes/data/Fig1_data.xlsx", sheet = "f_j")

# Recode TR: YN50 -> N50cont, NN50 -> N50cess, N0 -> Control
df <- df %>%
  mutate(TR = case_when(
    TR == "YN50" ~ "N50cont",
    TR == "NN50" ~ "N50cess",
    TR == "N0"   ~ "Control"
  )) %>%
  drop_na(all_amcc_5kb)

# Factor order: Control -> N50cess -> N50cont
df$TR <- factor(df$TR, levels = c("Control", "N50cess", "N50cont"))

# ---------- Sample size per group ----------
cat("======== Sample counts per group ========\n")
print(table(df$TR))

# ---------- Extract values per group ----------
Control <- df %>% filter(TR == "Control") %>% pull(all_amcc_5kb)
N50cess <- df %>% filter(TR == "N50cess") %>% pull(all_amcc_5kb)
N50cont <- df %>% filter(TR == "N50cont") %>% pull(all_amcc_5kb)

# ---------- 1. Welch's t-test (planned comparisons) ----------
t1 <- t.test(N50cess, Control, var.equal = FALSE)
t2 <- t.test(N50cont, Control, var.equal = FALSE)

p_raw <- c(t1$p.value, t2$p.value)

cat("\n--- Welch's t-test (uncorrected, planned comparisons) ---\n")
cat("N50cess vs Control: t =", round(t1$statistic, 3),
    " df =", round(t1$parameter, 2),
    " p =", p_raw[1], "\n")
cat("N50cont vs Control: t =", round(t2$statistic, 3),
    " df =", round(t2$parameter, 2),
    " p =", p_raw[2], "\n")

# ---------- 2. HTML annotation labels ----------
annot_labels <- c(
  sprintf("<b><i>t</i> = %.2f, <i>p</i> = %.3f</b>", t1$statistic, p_raw[1]),
  sprintf("<b><i>t</i> = %.2f, <i>p</i> = %.3f</b>", t2$statistic, p_raw[2])
)

# ---------- 3. Bracket positions based on data range ----------
y_max   <- max(df$all_amcc_5kb, na.rm = TRUE)
y_min   <- min(df$all_amcc_5kb, na.rm = TRUE)
y_range <- y_max - y_min

bracket_y1 <- y_max + y_range * 0.10   # lower bracket (N50cess vs Control)
bracket_y2 <- y_max + y_range * 0.30   # upper bracket (N50cont vs Control)
y_top      <- y_max + y_range * 0.60   # leave space for labels

tip <- y_range * 0.015

# ---------- 颜色：正红 / 正蓝（与 Fig1a-e 一致） ----------
col_ctrl <- "#c4c4c4"
col_blue <- "blue"
col_red  <- "red"

# 括号 + 标签数据框：第 1 行 = N50cess（蓝），第 2 行 = N50cont（红）
brk <- data.frame(
  x      = c(1.6, 2.2),
  xmin   = c(1, 1),
  xmax   = c(2, 3),
  y      = c(bracket_y1, bracket_y2),
  label  = annot_labels,
  col    = c(col_blue, col_red),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# ---------- 4. Plot ----------
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = TR, y = all_amcc_5kb, fill = TR)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3,
               alpha = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_point(aes(color = TR),
             size = 5.5, alpha = 0.5,
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, seed = 1),
             show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Treatment",
    values = c("Control" = col_ctrl, "N50cess" = col_blue, "N50cont" = col_red)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Treatment",
    values = c("Control" = col_ctrl, "N50cess" = col_blue, "N50cont" = col_red)
  ) +
  # ★ x 轴刻度标签：按因子水平顺序给字符向量（Control -> N50cess -> N50cont）
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c("Control",
               "N50<sub>cess</sub>",
               "N50<sub>cont</sub>")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(NA, y_top),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.02))
  ) +
  # ===== 蓝色括号 + 蓝色统计值（N50cess vs Control）=====
geom_segment(data = brk[1, ],
             aes(x = xmin, xend = xmax, y = y, yend = y),
             colour = col_blue, inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_segment(data = brk[1, ],
               aes(x = xmin, xend = xmin, y = y - tip, yend = y),
               colour = col_blue, inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_segment(data = brk[1, ],
               aes(x = xmax, xend = xmax, y = y - tip, yend = y),
               colour = col_blue, inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_richtext(data = brk[1, ],
                aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
                color = col_blue,
                inherit.aes = FALSE,
                size = 5.5, vjust = -0.25,
                fill = NA, label.color = NA,
                label.padding = unit(0, "pt")) +
  # ===== 红色括号 + 红色统计值（N50cont vs Control）=====
geom_segment(data = brk[2, ],
             aes(x = xmin, xend = xmax, y = y, yend = y),
             colour = col_red, inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_segment(data = brk[2, ],
               aes(x = xmin, xend = xmin, y = y - tip, yend = y),
               colour = col_red, inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_segment(data = brk[2, ],
               aes(x = xmax, xend = xmax, y = y - tip, yend = y),
               colour = col_red, inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_richtext(data = brk[2, ],
                aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
                color = col_red,
                inherit.aes = FALSE,
                size = 5.5, vjust = -0.25,
                fill = NA, label.color = NA,
                label.padding = unit(0, "pt")) +
  xlab(" ") +
  ylab("Relative abundance of AMCC (×/Gb)") +
  ggtitle("ARG and MRG co-located contigs (AMCC)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 16, family = "sans"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12, face = "bold"),
    # ★ x、y 轴分别设置 element_markdown，确保 x 轴 <sub> 被渲染
    axis.text.x = element_markdown(size = 18, colour = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_markdown(size = 16, colour = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 16, face = "bold"),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black",
                                size = 1.5, linetype = "solid"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
print(p)

# ---------- 5. Export ----------
ggsave("~/Desktop/codes/figures/Fig1f.pdf",
       p, width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 300,
       device = cairo_pdf)
```

```{r,fig.width=5,fig.height=5}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# Read data
df <- read_excel("~/Desktop/codes/data/Fig1_data.xlsx", sheet = "f_j")

# Recode TR: YN50 -> N50cont, NN50 -> N50cess, N0 -> Control
df <- df %>%
  mutate(TR = case_when(
    TR == "YN50" ~ "N50cont",
    TR == "NN50" ~ "N50cess",
    TR == "N0"   ~ "Control"
  )) %>%
  drop_na(mag)

# Factor order: Control -> N50cess -> N50cont
df$TR <- factor(df$TR, levels = c("Control", "N50cess", "N50cont"))

# ---------- Sample size per group ----------
cat("======== Sample counts per group ========\n")

Control <- df %>% filter(TR == "Control") %>% pull(mag)
N50cess <- df %>% filter(TR == "N50cess") %>% pull(mag)
N50cont <- df %>% filter(TR == "N50cont") %>% pull(mag)

# ---------- 1. Welch's t-test (planned comparisons) ----------
t1 <- t.test(N50cess, Control, var.equal = FALSE)
t2 <- t.test(N50cont, Control, var.equal = FALSE)

p_raw <- c(t1$p.value, t2$p.value)

cat("\n--- Welch's t-test (uncorrected, planned comparisons) ---\n")
cat("N50cess vs Control: t =", round(t1$statistic, 3),
    " df =", round(t1$parameter, 2),

cat("N50cont vs Control: t =", round(t2$statistic, 3),
    " df =", round(t2$parameter, 2),
    " p =", p_raw[2], "\n")

# ---------- 2. HTML annotation labels ----------
annot_labels <- c(
  sprintf("<b><i>t</i> = %.2f, <i>p</i> = %.3f</b>", t1$statistic, p_raw[1]),
  sprintf("<b><i>t</i> = %.2f, <i>p</i> = %.3f</b>", t2$statistic, p_raw[2])
)

# ---------- 3. Bracket positions based on data range ----------
y_max   <- max(df$mag, na.rm = TRUE)
y_min   <- min(df$mag, na.rm = TRUE)
y_range <- y_max - y_min

bracket_y1 <- y_max + y_range * 0.10   # lower bracket (Control vs N50cess)
bracket_y2 <- y_max + y_range * 0.30   # upper bracket (Control vs N50cont)
y_top      <- y_max + y_range * 0.65   # 给放大的标签留出顶部余量

tip <- y_range * 0.015

# ---------- 颜色：正红 / 正蓝（与 Fig1a-e、Fig1f 一致） ----------
col_ctrl <- "#c4c4c4"
col_blue <- "blue"
col_red  <- "red"

# 括号 + 标签数据框：第 1 行 = N50cess（蓝），第 2 行 = N50cont（红）
brk <- data.frame(
  x      = c(1.6, 2.2),
  xmin   = c(1, 1),
  xmax   = c(2, 3),
  y      = c(bracket_y1, bracket_y2),
  label  = annot_labels,
  col    = c(col_blue, col_red),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# ---------- 4. Plot ----------
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = TR, y = mag, fill = TR)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3,
               alpha = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA) +

             size = 5.5, alpha = 0.5,

    name = "Treatment",

  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Treatment",
    values = c("Control" = col_ctrl, "N50cess" = col_blue, "N50cont" = col_red)
  ) +
  # ★ x 轴刻度标签：按因子水平顺序给字符向量（Control -> N50cess -> N50cont）
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c("Control",
               "N50<sub>cess</sub>",
               "N50<sub>cont</sub>")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(NA, y_top),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.02))
  ) +
  # ===== 蓝色括号 + 蓝色统计值（N50cess vs Control）=====
geom_segment(data = brk[1, ],
             aes(x = xmin, xend = xmax, y = y, yend = y),
             colour = col_blue, inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_segment(data = brk[1, ],
               aes(x = xmin, xend = xmin, y = y - tip, yend = y),
               colour = col_blue, inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_segment(data = brk[1, ],
               aes(x = xmax, xend = xmax, y = y - tip, yend = y),
               colour = col_blue, inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_richtext(data = brk[1, ],
                aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
                color = col_blue,
                inherit.aes = FALSE,
                size = 5.5, vjust = -0.25,
                fill = NA, label.color = NA,
                label.padding = unit(0, "pt")) +
  # ===== 红色括号 + 红色统计值（N50cont vs Control）=====
geom_segment(data = brk[2, ],
             aes(x = xmin, xend = xmax, y = y, yend = y),
             colour = col_red, inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_segment(data = brk[2, ],
               aes(x = xmin, xend = xmin, y = y - tip, yend = y),
               colour = col_red, inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_segment(data = brk[2, ],
               aes(x = xmax, xend = xmax, y = y - tip, yend = y),
               colour = col_red, inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_richtext(data = brk[2, ],
                aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
                color = col_red,
                inherit.aes = FALSE,
                size = 5.5, vjust = -0.25,
                fill = NA, label.color = NA,
                label.padding = unit(0, "pt")) +
  xlab(" ") +
  ylab("Relative abundance of MAGs (%)") +
  ggtitle("Metagenome assembled genomes (MAGs)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 16, family = "sans"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
    # ★ x、y 轴分别设置 element_markdown，确保 x 轴 <sub> 被渲染
    axis.text.x = element_markdown(size = 18, colour = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_markdown(size = 16, colour = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 16, face = "bold"),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black",
                                size = 1.5, linetype = "solid"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
print(p)
```

```{r,fig.width=5,fig.height=5}
setwd("~/Desktop/codes")
rm(list = ls())

# ========== Stacked bar plot (mean): plasmid_arg + non_plasmid_arg, grouped by TR ==========
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readxl)
library(ggtext)     # ← 用于 HTML 渲染下标
df <- read_excel("~/Desktop/codes/data/Fig1_data.xlsx", sheet = "f_j")

# --- 1. Calculate non_plasmid_arg = total ARG_CARD - plasmid_arg ---
df$non_plasmid_arg <- df$ARG_CARD - df$plasmid_arg

# --- 2. Recode TR treatment: Control / N50cess / N50cont ---
df <- df %>%
  mutate(TR = case_when(
    TR == "N0"   ~ "Control",
    TR == "NN50" ~ "N50cess",
    TR == "YN50" ~ "N50cont",
    TRUE         ~ as.character(TR)
  ))

df$TR <- factor(df$TR, levels = c("Control", "N50cess", "N50cont"))

# --- 3. Compute mean by TR group (not sum) ---
df_sum <- df %>%
  group_by(TR) %>%
  summarise(
    plasmid_arg     = mean(plasmid_arg,     na.rm = TRUE),
    non_plasmid_arg = mean(non_plasmid_arg, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- 3b. Calculate percentage based on means ---
df_pct <- df_sum %>%
  mutate(
    total       = plasmid_arg + non_plasmid_arg,
    pct_plasmid = plasmid_arg / total * 100
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(TR, total, pct_plasmid)   # use dplyr:: to avoid MASS masking

cat("========Mean and percentage per group========\n")
print(df_pct)

# --- 4. Wide to long ---
df_long <- df_sum %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(plasmid_arg, non_plasmid_arg),
    names_to  = "Type",
    values_to = "Value"
  )

df_long$Type <- factor(df_long$Type, levels = c("plasmid_arg", "non_plasmid_arg"))

# --- 5. Plot ---
p <- ggplot(df_long, aes(x = TR, y = Value, fill = Type)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "plasmid_arg"     = "#C2185B",
      "non_plasmid_arg" = "#c4c4c4"
    ),
    labels = c("Plasmid borne ARGs", "Non plasmid ARGs")
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c("Control",
               "N50<sub>cess</sub>",
               "N50<sub>cont</sub>")
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = df_pct,
    aes(x = TR, y = total, label = sprintf("%.2f%%", pct_plasmid)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    vjust = -0.6, size = 4.5, fontface = "bold",
    color = "#C2185B"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  xlab(" ") +
  ylab(expression(bold("Relative abundance of ARGs (×/Gb)"))) +
  labs(fill = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    
    axis.text.x  = element_markdown(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 18,
                                    face = "bold", colour = "black"),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold",
                                colour = "black"),
    axis.title   = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold",
                                colour = "black"),
    
    legend.position      = "top",
    legend.justification = "center",
    legend.direction     = "horizontal",
    legend.background    = element_blank(),
    legend.key           = element_blank(),
    # ★ 图例文字加粗
    legend.text          = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.margin        = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    
    plot.margin = margin(t = 8, r = 8, b = 8, l = 8),
    
    panel.border = element_rect(size = 1.5, colour = "black", fill = NA),
    axis.line    = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks   = element_line(size = 1.5, colour = "black")
  )

print(p)

# --- 6. Export ---
ggsave("~/Desktop/codes/figures/Fig1i.pdf", p, width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r,fig.width=5,fig.height=5}
rm(list = ls())
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(readxl)
library(ggtext)     # ← 用于 HTML 渲染的标签（下标、斜体、粗体）
setwd("~/Desktop/codes")

# Read data
df <- read_excel("~/Desktop/codes/data/Fig1_data.xlsx", sheet = "f_j")

# Recode TR: YN50 -> N50cont, NN50 -> N50cess, N0 -> Control
df <- df %>%
  mutate(TR = case_when(
    TR == "YN50" ~ "N50cont",
    TR == "NN50" ~ "N50cess",
    TR == "N0"   ~ "Control"
  )) %>%
  drop_na(plasmid_amcc_5kb)

# Factor order: Control -> N50cess -> N50cont
df$TR <- factor(df$TR, levels = c("Control", "N50cess", "N50cont"))

# ---------- Sample size per group ----------
cat("======== Sample counts per group ========\n")
print(table(df$TR))

# ---------- Extract values per group ----------
Control <- df %>% filter(TR == "Control") %>% pull(plasmid_amcc_5kb)
N50cess <- df %>% filter(TR == "N50cess") %>% pull(plasmid_amcc_5kb)
N50cont <- df %>% filter(TR == "N50cont") %>% pull(plasmid_amcc_5kb)

# ---------- 1. Welch's t-test (planned comparisons) ----------
t1 <- t.test(N50cess, Control, var.equal = FALSE)
t2 <- t.test(N50cont, Control, var.equal = FALSE)

p_raw <- c(t1$p.value, t2$p.value)

cat("\n--- Welch's t-test (uncorrected, planned comparisons) ---\n")
cat("N50cess vs Control: t =", round(t1$statistic, 3),
    " df =", round(t1$parameter, 2),
    " p =", p_raw[1], "\n")
cat("N50cont vs Control: t =", round(t2$statistic, 3),
    " df =", round(t2$parameter, 2),
    " p =", p_raw[2], "\n")

# ---------- 2. HTML annotation labels ----------
annot_labels <- c(
  sprintf("<b><i>t</i> = %.2f, <i>p</i> = %.3f</b>", t1$statistic, p_raw[1]),
  sprintf("<b><i>t</i> = %.2f, <i>p</i> = %.3f</b>", t2$statistic, p_raw[2])
)

# ---------- 3. Bracket positions based on data range ----------
y_max   <- max(df$plasmid_amcc_5kb, na.rm = TRUE)
y_min   <- min(df$plasmid_amcc_5kb, na.rm = TRUE)
y_range <- y_max - y_min

bracket_y1 <- y_max + y_range * 0.10   # lower bracket (Control vs N50cess)
bracket_y2 <- y_max + y_range * 0.30   # upper bracket (Control vs N50cont)
y_top      <- y_max + y_range * 0.65   # 为放大的标签留白

tip <- y_range * 0.015

# ---------- 颜色：正红 / 正蓝（与 Fig1a-e、Fig1f、Fig1h 一致） ----------
col_ctrl <- "#c4c4c4"
col_blue <- "blue"
col_red  <- "red"

# 括号 + 标签数据框：第 1 行 = N50cess（蓝），第 2 行 = N50cont（红）
brk <- data.frame(
  x      = c(1.6, 2.2),
  xmin   = c(1, 1),
  xmax   = c(2, 3),
  y      = c(bracket_y1, bracket_y2),
  label  = annot_labels,
  col    = c(col_blue, col_red),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# ---------- 4. Plot ----------
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = TR, y = plasmid_amcc_5kb, fill = TR)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3,
               alpha = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_point(aes(color = TR),
             size = 5.5, alpha = 0.5,
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, seed = 1),
             show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Treatment",
    values = c("Control" = col_ctrl, "N50cess" = col_blue, "N50cont" = col_red)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Treatment",
    values = c("Control" = col_ctrl, "N50cess" = col_blue, "N50cont" = col_red)
  ) +
  # ★ x 轴刻度标签：按因子水平顺序给字符向量（Control -> N50cess -> N50cont）
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c("Control",
               "N50<sub>cess</sub>",
               "N50<sub>cont</sub>")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(NA, y_top),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.02))
  ) +
  # ===== 蓝色括号 + 蓝色统计值（N50cess vs Control）=====
geom_segment(data = brk[1, ],
             aes(x = xmin, xend = xmax, y = y, yend = y),
             colour = col_blue, inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_segment(data = brk[1, ],
               aes(x = xmin, xend = xmin, y = y - tip, yend = y),
               colour = col_blue, inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_segment(data = brk[1, ],
               aes(x = xmax, xend = xmax, y = y - tip, yend = y),
               colour = col_blue, inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_richtext(data = brk[1, ],
                aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
                color = col_blue,
                inherit.aes = FALSE,
                size = 5.5, vjust = -0.25,
                fill = NA, label.color = NA,
                label.padding = unit(0, "pt")) +
  # ===== 红色括号 + 红色统计值（N50cont vs Control）=====
geom_segment(data = brk[2, ],
             aes(x = xmin, xend = xmax, y = y, yend = y),
             colour = col_red, inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_segment(data = brk[2, ],
               aes(x = xmin, xend = xmin, y = y - tip, yend = y),
               colour = col_red, inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_segment(data = brk[2, ],
               aes(x = xmax, xend = xmax, y = y - tip, yend = y),
               colour = col_red, inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_richtext(data = brk[2, ],
                aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
                color = col_red,
                inherit.aes = FALSE,
                size = 5.5, vjust = -0.25,
                fill = NA, label.color = NA,
                label.padding = unit(0, "pt")) +
  xlab(" ") +
  ylab("Relative abundance of plasmid AMCC (×/Gb)") +
  ggtitle("ARG and MRG co-located on putative plasmid") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 16, family = "sans"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
    # ★ x、y 轴分别设置 element_markdown，确保 x 轴 <sub> 被渲染
    axis.text.x = element_markdown(size = 18, colour = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_markdown(size = 16, colour = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 16, face = "bold"),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black",
                                size = 1.5, linetype = "solid"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
print(p)

# ---------- 5. Export ----------
ggsave("~/Desktop/codes/figures/Fig1j.pdf",
       p, width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 300,
       device = cairo_pdf)
```
